{
  "files": {
    "rules/candidate_researcher_at_iis.pl": ":-( module(candidate_researcher_at_iis, [researcher_at_iis/2]).
:- use_module('../data/epoch_data.pl').

researcher_at_iis(Person, EvidenceFactIds) :-
    epoch_data:fact(FactIdA, Person, 'http://fogid.net/o/participant', iri('urn:logiclens:participation:work')),
    epoch_data:fact(FactIdB, 'urn:logiclens:org:iis', 'http://fogid.net/o/in-org', iri('urn:logiclens:participation:work')),
    epoch_data:fact(FactIdC, 'urn:logiclens:participation:work', 'http://fogid.net/o/role', literal("		}, "ru')),
    sort([FactIdA, FactIdB, FactIdC], EvidenceFactIds). )-.

:- begin_tests(candidate_researcher_at_iis).
:- use_module('../rules/candidate_researcher_at_iis.pl').

test(alex_is_researcher) :-
    researcher_at_iis('urn:logiclens:person:alex', EvidenceFactIds),
    member(f:sha256:681902c9a2d34fbc64bb898fe4594067db409d2839335ee98467e96bee2752df, EvidenceFactIds),
    member(f:sha256:9aa0dad76c25bdbbfde243a82b134e70a562d4843863f55dd1300dd1384955e5, EvidenceFactIds),
    member(f:sha256:67abb6c01dde5080956246e21c49cb00db0bf95376fa64213d04e4efe964271b, EvidenceFactIds).

:- end_tests(candidate_researcher_at_iis). )-.
